notes.title: Weatherman Updated Release Date & Demo Incoming
notes.notes:
Due to some unforeseen [strike]weather[/strike] conditions the team needs a bit more time to polish the skies and scare away the bugs at the news station. We are now aiming to release in [b]Early 2025[/b]. We also have a [b]demo in the works[/b] so please look forward to that.

We apologise for the disappointment this may cause but please bear with us as we work hard to deliver the best weather game that will surely blow you away.
